global: Long-form explainer (the Moon replaced by an equal-mass black hole; a 'holar' eclipse). Off-white canvas, black line art; grey Moon/Earth discs; dark-grey and black space scenes with white line art, white glow and stars; red for labels, scribbles, heat arrows, curves and a dark-red tail glow; one night street scene with a red tail-light glow. Opening presenter-with-paper and whiteboard with static question card; red series title card (animated mascot); then a BLACK HOLE MOON size gag, sieve and grain-scale scenes, a black-hole time diagram, split-screen orbit comparison, a sun-into-black-hole gravestone, night landscapes with bats, a dark accretion-disk and jet diagram, two figures under a night sky, temperature charts, an IR heat-path board, a lunar-lander punchline, and a final black-hole-eats-Earth sequence; red end card.

states.VS006: BLACK HOLE MOON title with a tiny dot (scene begins at the hidden hard cut f439|f440 out of the title card).
states.VS012: Presenter with a time-vs-distance black-hole diagram (scene begins at the hidden hard cut f885|f886 after three repeating sieve loops).
states.VS040: Presenter at whiteboard with red unit symbols °C °F K ? and a Moon sketch (scene begins at the hidden hard cut f3071|f3072 out of the orbit animation).
states.VS066: Red end card: original transfer must use an original series card (no source mascot, books, credits or URLs).

motion: Continuous loops on a static camera: three repeating sieve-pass loops f745-885 (a dot falls, each sieve bulges and lets it through, ~5-22k px/frame); split-screen orbit comparison f1062-1160 (Moon vs black-hole dot orbiting Earth, every frame, ~50k px/frame); Moon orbit with Earth rotation f2918-3071 (every frame, ~20-31k px/frame). Write-ons: shrinking ghost trail to a dot f71-73; temperature curve f2629-2632; typed red unit lines f3874-4148 (Fahrenheit, Rankine, Rømer, Réaumur, Kelvin); red CO2 curve and label f4289-4294; 600M_SUN typed f4841-4846. 1-frame swaps: trees -> street scene f1559. Transitions: rectangular staggered wipe reveals the jets f4897-4900; real 7-f zoom-out f4906-4912 as Earth stretches into a stream; blob morph f4925-4929; zoom-out/fade to a ring dot f4940-4945. Series title card f392-439 animates every frame. 22 hard cuts plus hidden cuts f439|f440, f885|f886, f3071|f3072.
continuity: The Moon and its black-hole replacement recur across board sketches, split-screen orbits, night skies and the closing sequence; the presenter and whiteboard recur; two night-sky figures recur (bare-headed, then in beanies and scarves); the IR heat-path board accumulates typed unit lines; dark space scenes share the dashed orbit circle. Replace the series mascot, title card, end card, books and credits; replace the real grain-size reference chart, the famous moon-landing quote and the lander design with original equivalents.
